answer: Each identity docks one earned relic at the wharf registry and locks a 70-credit bond in the haven vault. Fees climb a ladder: first relic 30 credits, k-th 30+6(k-1), thousandth 6,024. Auditors replay each relic's work log; a relic filed twice voids the bond, exposing rented-relic rings. Forging 1,000 identities costs 3,027,000 in fees, with 70,000 more locked; the pool pays at most 40,000. An honest agent files a single relic and pays 30 once.
